notes.title: Back from the grave!
notes.content:
With Halloween getting closer, it's high time to make a comeback with a few new tricks up my sleeve!

I've been torturing my fellow demonic developers, and forced them into making some improvements to my fantastic adventure:

	- New point of view and camera fix, no more motion sickness for weak and fragile gamers.
	- New save system
	- Once you finish the game, a new unlock mode will be available, to play again and again till you drop dead like me.
	- Colliders have been improved, no more excuse for not playing.
	- Graphic config can be switched directly frow the game pad
	- Graphics have been improved, say farewell to that 2016 feel

That's all, and that's enough. Play already!

Slimy kisses from the other side,


Lord Darydikilkil

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Like Lord Darydikilkil, we came back from the dead with a small update. 
7 epic success have been added, and we improved the camera angle, for a more comfortable 3rd person mode.

A few minor bugs have also been corrected.

Have fun (and a merry Xmas)!

notes.title: Lord Darydikilkil gifted to every Doll City early adopter!
notes.content:
Good news everyone!

We've decided to gift Lord Darydikilkil to every [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/468170] Doll City: Prologue 	[/url] early adopters, because you deserve it guys! So, if you still hesitate, you can buy Doll City and have both games for no extra charge! The game should pop up in your Steam library if you already own Doll City.

We've also read your comments, and are working on an update for Lord Darydikilkil. It should be released in a couple of days and address every issue that has been expressed, and more!

Thanks again for your support!


Team InfiniVerse

notes.title: Out (from the grave)
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Lord Darydikilkil's Revenge from Beyond The Grave (yeah, long title) is now released! 

We are the developers behind [url=store.steampowered.com/app/468170/] Doll City[/url], and we wanted to make a small dark and funny VR experience, inspired by early Tim Burton movies and games like MediEvil. Don't worry, we are still working like crazies to finsh Doll City, but we felt like making an extra effort to bring you something completely different.

So hop on, take your trusty gamepad and help Lord Darydikilkil fulfill his revenge!

We hope you will have as much fun playing this game as we had developing it! 


Cheers,


The InfiniVerse Team
